candidates.statement: • Determines whether a duplicate suitability petition was already approved or denied for the same change. If a petition for the same change has been denied, consideration should be given to whether there are any differences between the denied petition and the new petition that would allow the new petition to move forward.
candidates.context: Effective Date: 08/21/13, 8/10/18, 9/29/2023 Page 10 of 15 described in the suitability petition. • Determines if additional information is needed from the petitioner and drafts IR for the DFR PM to issue to petitioner.
